user_questions: Tell me about Ultimate Smile Design.
What does Ultimate Smile Design mean?
intents.voice_response: Ultimate Smile Design is a premium, personalised smile transformation concept. It combines digital smile planning, facial harmony analysis, and handcrafted artistry by Master Ceramists. Every smile is designed for your face and personality, never copied from a template.

user_questions: Can you share more details about USD?
What is the purpose of USD?
intents.voice_response: Ultimate Smile Design is the premium aesthetic brand of Advance Dental Export, created by Master Ceramist Haresh Savani. He built USD because a premium smile needs more than technology — it needs imagination, planning, and artistic craftsmanship backed by over 20 years of ceramic experience. That's why USD works only through Authorized USD Smile Designers, under the official USD Protocol.

user_questions: What is an Authorized USD Smile Designer?
intents.voice_response: An Authorized USD Smile Designer has completed the official USD training under Master Ceramist Haresh Savani and follows the USD Protocol. Many dentists can do routine smile work, but an Authorized designer focuses on facial harmony, digital planning, and handcrafted laboratory artistry, so your result is unique and natural.
